title: Evaluating Commonsense in Pre-trained Language Models
reasoning: The paper uses the Argument Reasoning Comprehension Task (ARCT) as one of its evaluation benchmarks. An example provided from this task involves reasoning about religious concepts (e.g., 'sin', 'Christians') and social/ethical issues (e.g., 'harmful atmosphere for gays'), thus evaluating the models on their ability to comprehend arguments with religious and ethical components.
